hypotheses.title: Subindustry Analyst Consensus Adjusted Net Income Yield Valuation Breakout
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Comparing consensus forward adjusted net income compiled across Wall Street analysts (adj_net_income_avg) to stock price over a 1-year rolling lookback (252 trading days) isolates companies experiencing clean operational earnings upgrades that the market has not yet priced in. Because adj_net_income_avg excludes non-recurring items and accounting write-offs, it provides a high-fidelity valuation yield signal. Ranking this metric cross-sectionally within subindustry and neutralizing by Industry in TOP1000 achieves exceptional risk-adjusted returns (Sharpe 1.74), strong capital deployment (Fitness 1.36), and robust decorrelation (self-correlation 0.4259).
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if consensus adjusted net income upgrades are driven by aggressive accounting management rather than genuine business margin expansion.

candidates.rationale: Alpha 9 Primary (8/8 PASS): 1-year analyst consensus adjusted net income yield in TOP1000 with Industry neutralization and decay=4
